name: OpenRCA
intro: OpenRCA 是 ICLR 2025 发布的根因分析基准与评测框架。论文从 AIOps Challenge 的三个真实企业系统筛选1,753条故障记录，平衡为412条，再经统一格式和三名工程师基于遥测校准过滤为335个案例；Telecom、Bank、Market分别含51、136、148例，配套68.5GB、523M行去标识化指标、日志和追踪。七种任务要求预测故障时间、根因组件、根因原因的非空子集；主指标仅在全部被要求要素匹配时计为正确，时间允许正负一分钟。
org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Microsoft, Tsinghua University
build_method: AIOps系统筛选；数据规模平衡；名称、模式和遥测格式统一；三名工程师基于遥测校准与过滤；七种目标规格采样；大模型查询合成和人工核验
metric: 严格根因准确率：组件与原因精确匹配，时间允许正负一分钟；仅全部被要求要素匹配的案例计为正确
openness: public code and externally hosted data; MIT code, CC-BY-NC-4.0 telemetry
modality: 文本, 时间序列指标, 日志, 追踪图
task_type: 根因分析, Agent诊断, 开放式结构化预测
eval_feature: 七种根因目标；平衡抽样、Oracle抽样与RCA-agent三类方法；类JSON预测解析和多故障排列匹配；实现保留部分诊断分，但论文主指标仅统计score==1.0
scale: 335个故障案例（Telecom 51、Bank 136、Market 148）；68.5GB、523M行遥测；73个根因组件、28种根因原因
openness_en: Public Code and Externally Hosted Data; MIT Code, CC-BY-NC-4.0 Telemetry
modality_en: Text, Time-series Metrics, Logs, Trace Graphs
task_type_en: Root-cause Analysis, Agent Diagnosis, Open-ended Structured Prediction
build_method_en: AIOps System Selection; Dataset Balancing; Name, Schema, and Telemetry Standardization; Three-engineer Telemetry-grounded Calibration and Filtering; Seven-goal Specification Sampling; LLM Query Synthesis and Human Verification
eval_feature_en: Seven Root-cause Goals; Balanced Sampling, Oracle Sampling, and RCA-agent; JSON-like Prediction Parsing and Permutation Matching for Multiple Failures; Partial Diagnostic Fractions in the Implementation but score==1.0 Only for the Paper Headline Metric
intro_en: OpenRCA is an ICLR 2025 root-cause-analysis benchmark and evaluation framework. The paper selects 1,753 failure records from three real enterprise systems in the AIOps Challenge series, balances them to 412, then standardizes the data and has three engineers calibrate and filter telemetry-grounded labels into 335 cases. Telecom, Bank, and Market contribute 51, 136, and 148 cases with 68.5 GB and 523M lines of de-identified metrics, logs, and traces. Seven task types request non-empty subsets of failure time, root-cause component, and root-cause reason. A case is correct only when every requested element matches, with a plus-or-minus one-minute time tolerance.
scale_en: 335 failure cases (Telecom 51, Bank 136, Market 148); 68.5 GB and 523M telemetry lines; 73 root-cause components and 28 root-cause reasons
metric_en: Strict Root-cause Accuracy: exact component and reason, plus-or-minus one minute for time; a case is correct only when all requested elements match

drawio_review_note: source_stage=paper-alignment; reviewed_at=2026-07-22; benchmark=OpenRCA; formal_assets_intentionally_not_modified=true. Paper evidence: the canonical accepted asset is the ICLR 2025 proceedings page https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/hash/d29b8d53678015079e1d245c023e49d2-Abstract-Conference.html and its fixed 29-page conference PDF https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/file/d29b8d53678015079e1d245c023e49d2-Paper-Conference.pdf. The downloaded PDF SHA256 is 3cd926feb85119dbb0927e856366e36b0f0794a3b16ea0950a8b4c13cd54fe2a. OpenReview forum M4qNIzQYpd remains the review record, but direct OpenReview PDF/API retrieval returned HTTP 403 in this environment; the official proceedings asset supplies the fixed accepted revision without relying on a mirror. Construction evidence: Section 2.4 describes four stages. System selection chooses the Telecom database, Bank, and online Market systems from the AIOps Challenge series, retaining 1,753 records. Data balancing downsamples the larger datasets to reduce a scale difference of up to two orders of magnitude, leaving 412 records. Data calibration first standardizes names, input-output schemas, and telemetry formats, then three software engineers inspect telemetry to verify root-cause time, component, and reason. Cases with missing telemetry, unidentifiable root causes, or disagreement between labels and observable telemetry are removed, yielding 335 cases. Query synthesis samples one of seven goals, builds a specification with system, a 30-minute time window, and failure count when necessary, asks an LLM such as GPT-4 to verbalize the request, and applies human verification. Scale evidence: Table 1 fixes Telecom at 51 cases, 15 unique root-cause components, 5 reasons, 17.6 GB, and 154M telemetry lines; Bank at 136 cases, 14 components, 8 reasons, 26.4 GB, and 248M lines; Market at 148 cases, 44 components, 15 reasons, 24.5 GB, and 121M lines. The total is 335 cases, 73 components, 28 reasons, 68.5 GB, and 523M lines. Metrics, semi-structured logs, and dependency traces are de-identified. The repository does not embed these 68.5 GB assets: dataset/README.md only links Google Drive, so this review did not download or independently recount the telemetry. The graph records this as a dashed access boundary rather than implying local materialization. Task evidence: failure time, root-cause component, and root-cause reason are the three possible target elements. Their seven non-empty subsets form tasks 1 through 7. Tasks requesting one, two, and three elements are grouped as easy, middle, and hard. A natural-language query and its corresponding telemetry are inputs; the expected output is JSON-like structured text containing the requested fields. When multiple failures occur, the query includes the failure count and predictions are matched under permutations rather than a fixed order. Method evidence: the paper compares balanced sampling, oracle sampling, and RCA-agent. Sampling first downsamples all telemetry, including metrics, traces, and logs, to one-minute frequency. Balanced sampling then stratifies KPI types within metric files, repeats the randomized procedure three times, and reports the median; oracle sampling uses engineer-identified golden KPIs as an upper-bound baseline. RCA-agent separates a Controller that plans analysis from an Executor that writes and executes Python over metrics, traces, and logs, avoiding direct placement of all telemetry in the LLM context. The graph keeps these as three branches that converge before parsing; it does not imply that Oracle information is available to an ordinary agent. Metric evidence: paper Section 2.3 assigns one point only if all requested root-cause elements match and zero if any mismatch occurs, then averages accuracy. For time, Section 4 and the released scorer allow an absolute difference of at most 60 seconds. Component and reason require exact string equality. At Git revision c1bd4af7f635171a1c31cdd567c07d698dff6abc, main/evaluate.py parses JSON-like predictions, permutation-matches multiple failures, computes an element-level fraction rounded to two decimals, and stores that fraction as score. Its report function clearly labels Strict Accuracy and counts only rows where score==1.0; it separately calculates partial accuracy. The headline benchmark metric is the strict score, while fractions are diagnostics. This implementation distinction is preserved in element_score, strict, and implementation_boundary nodes. Result evidence: the paper reports accuracy by method and goal difficulty and states that the best model under RCA-agent, Claude 3.5, reaches 11.34 percent overall. This result is descriptive evidence of benchmark difficulty, not a current leaderboard. The detail retains has_leaderboard=false. Repository snapshot evidence: official microsoft/OpenRCA HEAD resolved with git ls-remote to c1bd4af7f635171a1c31cdd567c07d698dff6abc and was shallow-cloned at that exact commit. The pinned README SHA256 is c08d18bd45b1dbb0ce06964095b91da4b55457fa04ae134c4920256ed04a3e3d; main/evaluate.py SHA256 is 9a1c235139266c32b0e95c7e9938591b8fe014aad4cde95580f73f13a54d53f1; main/task_specification.json SHA256 is 113bf4b60731f967a51ece5dcc5901647014041873d1ddd7a4cc70837354dec9; dataset/README.md SHA256 is 22766aad8116f3e936957980772167e427a6ad3b5a28591e93d8de4c8a3707f2. GitHub lists no tagged release, so the graph explicitly separates the fixed ICLR paper asset from this current repository snapshot. Openness evidence: the repository root LICENSE at the fixed commit has SHA256 c2cfccb812fe482101a8f04597dfc5a9991a6b2748266c47ac91b6a5aae15383 and declares MIT terms for code. The paper Ethics Statement and Appendix A.1 state that telemetry originates from the AIOps Challenge series under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0. That license permits non-commercial reuse, sharing, and adaptation with attribution; the paper separately says derivatives should be shared under identical terms. A single public label would hide these distinct obligations, so the diagram places MIT code and CC BY-NC 4.0 telemetry in a dashed license boundary. Diagram contract: English and Chinese specs use the same 26 node IDs, 27 edges, node types, sizes, coordinates, and edge styles. Construction nodes are evidence, raw, select, records, balance, standardize, calibrate, filter, dataset, goals, spec, synthesize, and verify. Evaluation nodes are query, run_gate, balanced, oracle, agent, parse, element_score, strict, and report. Boundary nodes are version_boundary, access_boundary, license_boundary, and implementation_boundary. All five secondary edges explicitly set style.dashed=true. English labels contain no Han characters; every Chinese node contains Chinese semantics. The detail Mermaid fallbacks are generated exactly from the two source specs. Formal Draw.io, arch JSON, SVG, PNG, catalog, manifest, queue reports, and sync scripts are intentionally outside this source-stage patch. Formal publication evidence [site-a12b-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1445×1425 (English) and 1445×1425 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1443×1423 and 1443×1423. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
